༄༅/ /sgra mi snyan gyi tshe sgrub 'khrul snang du slob dpon chen po'i drung du mnos pa'i lo rgyus bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sgra mi snyan gyi tshe sgrub 'khrul snang du slob dpon chen po'i drung du mnos pa'i lo rgyus bzhugs so//

/de yang chu mo glang lo hor zla lnga pa'i tshes bco lnga'i nub mo/ byang gnam mtsho'i bkra shis do bo cher gnas zhag bgyis te yod pa'i skabs shig gnyid du song ba'i nyams snang du bu mo ras gos gyon pa mda' dar dang lcags kyu thogs pa zhig byung ste/ nga ni rgya gar gyi grong khyer ser skya nas 'ong ba yin rje btsun chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis do nub tshogs kyi 'khor lo zhig dang tshe'i dbang bskur zab mo zhig byed dgos pa sngon gyi smon lam mthu btsan pa yin zhes zer bas de dang sdebs te phyin pa las/ grong khyer chen po zhig gi dbus su sngags 'chang chen po zhig a ru ra'i sdong po la rgyab gtad de bzhugs 'dug pa mjal zhing bsdad de/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i mod la sngags 'chang des tshe dbang 'di yongs su rdzogs par bskur te/ khyod kyis tshe dbang 'di sngon chad dā na shrīs bod du gnang ba las cung zad rgyas par yod cing 'di dngos gzhi sta gon dang 'brel bas rten 'brel rmad du byung ba yin pas bod du spel bar gyis shig /sngon du rdzogs ldan gyi bskal pa bzang lags kyang*/ da dus dus ngan snyigs ma lnga bdo la// bod du mi bzang mtshan ma sna tshogs 'byung*// khyad par lcags byi gnam lo shar ba'i dus// bod khams a dro ra yi dmag gis 'joms// mtha' dkyil log pas sangs rgyas bstan pa nyams// khyad par a ming khyi lo pa zhig 'byung*// des ni bod kun sdug la gtod par byed// nam zhig rigs yal rgyud nyams chos kyang nyams// nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de dag gsal bar 'byung*// ma ran bar du ma ston rgya yis thob// chos 'di spel la tshig 'di dam du chongs// zhes gsungs te bdag tshur log 'ong ba'i snang ba byung ste// gnyid sad byung ba na nam langs 'dug go// zhes pa 'di'ang nyams snang byung tshul lo rgyus su bkod pa/ shākya'i dge slong dkon mchog ming gis bris/

gzhan yang bdag rang gi tshe tshad dang mtha' dmag dbus su yong mi yong byang bod rnams kyi skyid sdug legs nyes ji ltar yong sogs mang du lung bstan pa'i snang ba byung yang*/ zog rdzu'i rgyur 'gro zhing bka' rgya yang dam par 'dug pas re zhig ma bris par chos skyong rnams kyis bzod par mdzod cig/ //shu bhaṃ/
